newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - April 11.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Commentary said Beijing's decision to allow selected state firms to issue four billion yuan worth of convertible bonds signals the start of a real CB market.
- Deputy Shanghai mayor Zhao Qizheng says Shanghai and Hong Kong will complement each other after Chinese takeover of the British colony.
- Some Chinese firms plan to base the price of rights issues on quoted share prices for the first time.
- BUSINESS NEWS - The Shanghai branch of the Agricultural Bank of China has offered a 1.018 billion yuan loan for the development of Pudong.
- China's demand for imported cars is seen as increasing little this year due to high domestic inventory.
